name: CreateResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The name of the common resource group. The name must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_), up to 128 characters
parameters.help_zh: 创建通用资源组的名称，必须以字母开头，可包含字母、数字、下划线（_），最多128个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: Create a serverless resource group for common tasks
parameters.help_en: The remarks for the common resource group. The remarks can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, and underscores (_), up to 128 characters
parameters.help_zh: 创建通用资源组的备注，可包含字母、中文、数字、下划线（_），最多128个字符
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The payment type of the resource group. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh: 资源组的付费类型，PrePaid代表包年包月，PostPaid代表按量付费
parameters.name: payment_type

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the payment duration. Valid values:
Month: monthly subscription.
Year: yearly subscription
parameters.help_zh: 付费时长单位，Month代表包月，Year代表包年
parameters.name: payment_duration_unit

parameters.help_en: The resource group specification, in CUs. This parameter is required when the payment type is PrePaid
parameters.help_zh: 资源组规格,单位CU，当资源组付费模式为PrePaid时，必填
parameters.name: spec
